title: Topology on the automorphism group of a functor to finite sets
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Sets}$ a functor with $F(X)$ finite for every object $X$. The group $\operatorname{Aut}(F)$ of natural automorphisms of $F$ maps injectively to $\prod_{X\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)}\operatorname{Aut}(F(X))$ by $\gamma\mapsto(\gamma_X)_X$, its image being the families compatible with all $F(f)$; $\operatorname{Aut}(F)$ carries the topology induced by this map from the product of the discrete topologies on the finite groups $\operatorname{Aut}(F(X))$.
